description: net_worth is computed as Number(reader.usdcBalanceAtomic(id))/1e6 (enrich.js:24). usdcBalanceAtomic is a bigint of 6-dp atomic units; Number() silently loses integer precision above 2^53 (~9.007e15 atomic = ~$9.007e9 USDC). A whale balance beyond that yields a rounded (wrong) net_worth with src='chain' — a silently-corrupt VERIFIED figure that then feeds ranking and totals. No test exercises the Number(bigint) path with a value > 2^53; every fixture uses tiny balances (1_000000n). The verification-architecture R3 row claims 'dimensioned, exact' — exactness above 2^53 is neither implemented (no BigInt-scaled arithmetic) nor tested.
fix: Either document the safe ceiling, or scale with BigInt before Number() (e.g. Number(atomic / 10000n)/100). Add a >2^53 fixture asserting exactness/behavior.
